**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The document contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee payable by our parties (Verizon Owner Trust 2020-A as Issuer or Verizon ABS LLC as Depositor):

- **No LD/penalty language exists.** Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee" and "premium" return nothing chargeable to us.
- **Section 8.3 (Termination)** ends the Agreement on the last-receivable/trust-termination events with no exit payment to Cellco.
- **Make-Whole Payments are not Customer-payable LDs.** They are noteholder redemption economics triggered by the Class A Certificateholder's own election under Section 8.2(a) (an Originator/Cellco affiliate), and the funding conditions in §§8.1 and 8.2 require that party to deposit an amount covering the Note Balance, interest and any unpaid Make-Whole Payments. The Clean-Up Redemption under Section 8.1(a) is expressly "without any Make-Whole Payment."
- **Directionally favorable provisions confirmed:** the Article VI indemnities run from the Servicer/Marketing Agent to the Indemnified Persons (toward us), and the dispute-resolution clause denies the arbitral panel power to award punitive or consequential damages.

This satisfies the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback, so no edit is warranted.
